g.text: Vehicle Rental Management System - Sequence Diagram
The program is a synchronous, in-memory menu application.
main() registers users and dispatches their menu choices.
readInt()/readDouble() retry invalid numeric input and exit
Select renter; enter ID, name, phone
Select Add; enter name, price, vehicle ID
Select Show All or Show Available
print all, or only isAvailable() vehicles
Admin panel (no admin object or authentication in source)
Display renter details or empty-list message
Display customer details or empty-list message
Select customer; enter ID, name, phone, license
construct customer(name, id, phone, license, db)
Select Show All or Show Available
print all, or only isAvailable() vehicles
Select Book; enter vehicle ID and rental days
Days must be greater than zero
bookVehicle_D checks only whether the ID exists;
it does not reject a vehicle already marked rented.
Select Calculate Bill; enter vehicle ID
Select Discounted Bill; enter ID and percentage
